name: MACS J1023.8-2715 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J1023.8-2715, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj102382715-hubble
story: A rich cluster of galaxies, one of the extreme, X-ray-bright clusters that Hubble swept up in a quick snapshot survey. Clusters like this act as gravitational telescopes, magnifying galaxies far behind them.

claims.text: MACSJ1023.8-2715 is a target of HST program 16670, a SNAPshot survey of extreme galaxy clusters
The survey targets highly X-ray luminous clusters; its targets are listed as rich clusters
The survey aims to find powerful gravitational lenses ('gravitational telescopes')
